Following Bills were introduced in Lok Sabha on the 23rd November, 1962: (BILL No. 115 OF 1962)A Bill further to amend the Income-tax Act, 1961 and the Wealth-tax Act, 1957.
A Bill further to amend the Income-tax Act, 1961, the Wealth-tax Act, 1957 and the Gift-tax Act, 1958.-BE it enacted by Parliament in the Twenty-second Year of the Republic of India as follows:
